DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.

Your history of heavy smoking, significant weight loss, obstructive jaundice, and a history of upper abdominal pain is classic for pancreatic cancer. The ultrasound and liver panel I ordered earlier confirmed a mass in the head of the pancreas causing the blockage.
